Thailand School Shooting: Teenager Kills Multiple People Before Suicide

A 14-year-old gunman killed at least seven people, including children and school staff, in a rampage at a childcare center and school near Bangkok, Thailand. The attacker also killed his grandparents before the school incident. He died by suicide after the shooting. Reports indicate at least 23 people were wounded, with some in critical condition. The shooter used his grandfather's firearm. The incident has led to renewed pressure on Thailand's gun laws.
